The '''signal-augmented sensor jammer''' was a device used to jam [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Such a device was produced by [[Carbanti United Electronics/Legends|Carbanti United Electronics]].<ref name="SWS" /> [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] found one of these amidst cargo on [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jarril]]'s [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Spicy Lady]]'', in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].<ref name="TNR">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>
